incident: Legacy test_v08_cold_boot.py was invoked with --help during inspection. The script has no argparse help path and compiled its temporary harness before attempting to execute it with --help as the ROM argument.
remediation: Added v10-build-policy.json and run_v10_nonbuild_gate.sh. Build-capable legacy tests are now explicitly inventoried and must not be invoked during ordinary non-build work, including for help/discovery.
standing_policy: No compilation/build unless explicitly requested by the user.
